tested_object: Relative one-hour linear accessibility from N0 contexts of 16h, 32h, 64h, and 128h under one fixed ridge probe family on common timestamps

research_series_policy.adaptation_rationale: R5 found no longer-horizon candidate and the 1h reference remained the strongest point estimate; R6 screens whether the fixed 64h state window itself is a poor MVP choice before changing model machinery
research_series_policy.if_candidate_found: promote only the named context-length candidate to a new separately preregistered qualification/transfer experiment
research_series_policy.if_no_candidate_found: do_not_rescue_R6; no screened context length receives promotion

adaptations_made_after_exposure: R6 context-length set and screening question selected after R3-R5 one-hour/horizon diagnostics

claims.tested_object: bounded comparative screen of N0 context lengths 16h/32h/128h against the 64h reference using a fixed one-hour ridge probe

estimand.primary: for each candidate context: February Pearson correlation, true-minus-median-shuffle correlation, and paired correlation gain over the 64h reference under common resamples
estimand.candidate_rule: all three one-sided bootstrap lower bounds > 0; among eligible contexts choose highest point true correlation, exact tie to shorter context
estimand.unit: dependence-aware 48h moving blocks over the common February hourly sequence

claims.estimator: context-specific January feature standardization + closed-form ridge(lambda=1), February Pearson correlation, eight matched shuffled-January-target controls, paired circular moving-block bootstrap
claims.replication_unit: 48h circular moving block; 4096 bootstrap replicates are uncertainty draws, not independent scientific replicates
validity_prerequisites: same common first-consequence timestamps for all context lengths
same one-hour target timestamps for all context lengths
each N0 context uses only hours strictly before consequence hour
same January target permutation for a given control seed across all context lengths
same bootstrap resamples across all contexts and controls
no February fitting or context selection during fitting
credible_alternatives: apparent context gain from sample-window differences is controlled by common timestamps
apparent predictability from fitting noise is characterized by matched shuffled-January-target controls
feature dimension changes with context length; fixed ridge lambda does not resolve dimension-dependent regularization and any candidate requires follow-up
adaptive reuse/multiplicity remains unresolved and therefore screening cannot be confirmatory
authority_scope: may prioritize one screened context length as a candidate for a new formal follow-up
may conclude that none of the screened alternative context lengths earned screening promotion

composition_dependencies.ref: 64h context may be an arbitrary MVP timescale

screen.target_formula: close[first_consequence_hour] / open[first_consequence_hour] - 1.0; every N0 state uses only hours strictly before first_consequence_hour
screen.feature_standardization: context-specific January common-fit mean/population-std; drop std<=1e-12; freeze for February
screen.candidate_selection: eligible context with highest point true correlation; exact tie selects shorter context

uncertainty_protocol.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over common February hourly indices
